title: In an abstract Setoid-flavored ring, any element times zero is equivalent to zero
statement: For any AlgS.Ring record R (an abstract carrier, a caller-supplied equivalence relation equiv with congruence fields for add/mul/neg, additive commutative group and distributive laws stated over equiv rather than Eq) and any a of R's carrier, equiv (mul a zero) zero -- derived from the additive-group and distributive axioms alone, without ever using a multiplicative identity, and using the explicit add/mul congruence fields wherever the Eq-flavored Alg.ringMulZero would have used automatic congr_arg.

formal.statement: theorem AlgS.mul_zero : ((x0 : AlgS.Ring) -> ((x1 : AlgS.Ring.carrier x0) -> AlgS.Ring.equiv x0 (AlgS.Ring.mul x0 x1 (AlgS.Ring.zero x0)) (AlgS.Ring.zero x0)))

evidence.supports: AlgS.mul_zero admits through the trusted kernel gate, and instantiated at CReal.commRingS's AlgS.CommRing.toRingS projection (a Setoid carrier whose equality, CReal.Equiv, is not Eq -- the exact carrier the Eq-flavored Alg.ringMulZero cannot reach, per ADR-1587's widened-search finding), applied at a genuinely free `a : CReal`, is `def_eq` to CReal.mul_zero's own rendered type.
evidence.checker_command: out=$(RUST_MIN_STACK=1073741824 cargo test -p axeyum-lean-kernel --lib --release -- generic_mul_zero_instantiated_at_creal_matches_creal_mul_zero_type --test-threads=1 2>&1) && test "$(printf "%s\n" "$out" | grep -cE 'test result: ok\. 1 passed; 0 failed')" -ge 1
evidence.notes: The pinned pattern requires BOTH counts ('1 passed; 0 failed'); the test's own assertion is a `Kernel::def_eq_in` comparison against `CReal.mul_zero`'s inferred type in a real `LocalContext`, not a string match.

provenance.established_by: axeyum-lean-kernel nat_prelude::structures_setoid (declare_mul_zero), lane structures-setoid, ADR-1588 -- proved once over the abstract AlgS.Ring record, closing the gap ADR-1587 measured (CReal.mul_zero structurally unreachable from the Eq-flavored Alg spine).

notes: The Setoid-flavored twin of F:alg-ring-mul-zero (ADR-1578); see ADR-1588 for the design (nine AlgS.* records, an explicit equiv relation and congruence field per operation, no coercion from the Eq-flavored spine). Instantiated at both Int (through AlgS.Ring.ofAlg, applied to Alg.Ring == Int.ring) and CReal (directly, via CReal.commRingS).
